parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part includes one blade and one handle of the scissors, made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism and provides one grip for the user to hold and apply force.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw to open and close against the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part includes the second blade and handle of the scissors, also made of stainless steel and plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the other half of the cutting mechanism and provides the second grip for the user.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw in coordination with the first blade handle set to perform cutting.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade handle sets at their pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the two blade handle sets together and allows them to rotate smoothly around the pivot.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place while allowing rotational movement of the blades around it.
